verdict.rationale: The dedicated scrape endpoint turns a single URL into text. For batch work, enrichments fill columns from input rows using web scrapes, accept up to 10,000 rows per /enrich request, and run asynchronously with webhook delivery or SDK polling (wait_for_result). That covers thousands of URLs asynchronously, but only through the AI enrichment workflow rather than a native bulk-scrape API. Missing for 10: a documented batch/async mode for the raw scrape endpoint, throughput or concurrency details for large URL lists, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scraping at scale.
